nodes.dialogue_text: On the ninth day Bhishma's host cannot be broken. The Pandava line bends, and Krishna's anger flares.
Arjuna, you fight like a man who loves his enemies! If you will not strike Bhishma, I will. I will take up a wheel of this chariot and end him myself.

choices.choice_text: [Hold Krishna back. Obey his command and press the attack.]

nodes.dialogue_text: Stay your hand, Madhava! You gave your word not to take up arms. I will fight. Your anger is not needed.
